$comment: Streaming engine via the generic WebSocket adapter. Parameters from AssemblyAI's streaming API reference (checked 2026-10-12). Universal-3.5 Pro Realtime supports 18 languages (no Urdu). Languages are sent as language_codes; with none set the model auto-detects. Flush variant: at the end of the audio sends ForceEndpoint before Terminate, so the turn in progress is finalised rather than left open.
label: AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro (flush at end)
